title: dasiphora fruticosa var. leucantha
intro: Dasiphora fruticosa var. leucantha, commonly known as Russian Sage, is a flowering perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Asia and Europe. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and improving respiratory health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and display antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Russian Sage include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
